question: As notified in June 2025, which of the following insurance companies launched India’s first car insurance with built-in crash detection, auto claims trigger?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zuno General Insurance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zuno General Insurance**, formerly known as Edelweiss General Insurance, launched **India's first car insurance policy** with built-in crash detection and auto claims trigger in **June 2025**.
 
• This innovative insurance product uses **advanced telematics** and **IoT (Internet of Things) technology** to detect car crashes accurately and initiate claims automatically.
 
• The crash detection feature ensures that policyholders get immediate assistance in case of an accident, improving the **response time** and reducing hassles during emergencies.
 
• The auto claims trigger functionality helps in streamlining the claims process, making it quicker and more efficient for customers.
 
• This new car insurance policy highlights **Zuno General Insurance's** commitment to leveraging technology for enhancing customer experience and safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Telematics Technology in Insurance:**

 
 
• Telematics refers to the integration of **communication technologies** with vehicles, enabling real-time data collection and analysis.
 
• It helps insurance companies monitor driving behavior, vehicle usage, and accident patterns to offer **customized premiums** and improve road safety.
 
• Telematics-based insurance policies are often referred to as **usage-based insurance (UBI)** or pay-as-you-drive insurance.
 
 
 
• **IoT in Car Insurance:**
 
 
• The **Internet of Things (IoT)** enables devices and vehicles to communicate and share data seamlessly.
 
• IoT applications in car insurance include crash detection, real-time location tracking, theft prevention, and maintenance alerts.
 
• These technologies enhance customer safety and reduce the **administrative burden** on insurance providers.
 
 
 
• **Other Innovations in Insurance:**
 
 
• Many insurance companies are adopting **AI-powered chatbots**, mobile apps, and blockchain technologies to improve customer service and claims processing.
 
• Some insurers offer **on-demand insurance**, allowing customers to purchase coverage only when needed, such as for short-term travel or specific events.
 
 
 
• **About Zuno General Insurance:**
 
 
• Zuno General Insurance is a prominent player in the Indian insurance market, known for its **tech-driven solutions** and customer-centric approach.
 
• The company rebranded from Edelweiss General Insurance to Zuno General Insurance to reflect its focus on **innovation and digital transformation**.
 
• Zuno offers a wide range of insurance products, including health, motor, and travel insurance, designed to cater to the evolving needs of modern customers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Crash Detection Technology:**

 
 
• Crash detection involves using **sensors, accelerometers, and algorithms** to identify collisions and determine their severity.
 
• This technology can automatically alert emergency services, insurance companies, and family members in case of an accident.
 
 
 
• **Auto Claims Trigger:**
 
 
• The auto claims trigger feature ensures that claims are initiated automatically after a crash is detected, reducing paperwork and saving time for policyholders.
 
• This functionality relies on real-time data transmission and integration with the insurer's backend systems.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Tech-Driven Insurance:**
 
 
• Enhanced **customer experience** through faster claims processing and personalized policies.
 
• Improved **road safety** due to better monitoring and preventive measures.
 
• Cost efficiency for insurers and policyholders by minimizing fraudulent claims and optimizing premiums.
